High-level ask:
- CS (Monica): confirm which accounts in the attached sheet are truly committed (signed PO / verbal ITO + procurement date). Mark any that are >30% risk.
- AE (Priyom): confirm gating open items (SLA exceptions, EDR requests, procurement timeline).
- Finance (Kimberly): confirm how you want partial-commit treatment (do we carry as commit or upside).

Checklist (in the sheet):
1) Account name / ARR impact / current stage
2) Evidence column: PO/Email/DS link
3) Procurement ETA
4) Risk level (LOW/MED/HIGH) + rationale

I've attached the Q4-commit-spreadsheet.xlsx with the current allocations. Monica — can you drop your initial pass by EOD Monday? If anything is ambiguous, tag me and Marissa.
